10090|0e051c59.name: Belia Thundergranite
10090|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

11096|904d1c22.name: Randal Worth
11096|904d1c22.text: There's nothing I can teach you, other than maybe a better eye for color and detail. Talk to Simon Tanner over there; he knows a lot of advanced techniques for working with leather.

12656|307aaccf.name: Thamarian
12656|307aaccf.text:
On the northern dock, you can board a ship that will carry you to Rut'theran Village and Darnassus. From the southern dock, you can find passage across the Great Sea to Menethil Harbor on Khaz Modan, and onwards to Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you head to the western dock, you can board a ship setting sail for Stormwind.

Safe journeys to you!

1285|ed056522.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1286|ed056522.name: Edna Mullby
1286|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

13084|554a4659.name: Bixi Wobblebonk
13084|554a4659.text: Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

1355|0c543544.name: Cook Ghilm
1355|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1719|bf4c7bb7.name: Warden Thelwater
1719|bf4c7bb7.text: Over here, you worthless...! If you want to do something useful, listen quick!

1976|02b586f6.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|02b586f6.text: You're into leather, eh?  Sounds like you should talk to Simon Tanner over in Old Town.  He runs a shop there called the Protective Hide.

1976|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

1976|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

214954|6cf4abd2.name: Rix Xizzix
214954|6cf4abd2.text:
Welcome to the Xizzix Asset Recovery Service! If you lost it, we probably found it! 

Check my stock to see if we've recovered anything that you might have carelessly discarded and have since decided you just can't live without.

230319|6e77bf25.name: Deliana
230319|6e77bf25.text: Try not to draw too much attention, I'm waiting for the King to grant me audience.  Not that I mind waiting, I feel pretty safe around all these burly guards.

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

274781|1c500d9f.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|1c500d9f.text: Skinning?  The only thing ye look like ye could skin is yer own knee!  Ha!  Now why don't you go see Balthus Stoneflayer so he can teach you how to properly skin some animals.  You'll find him in Finespindle's Leather Goods on the northern side of The Great Forge.

274781|3804779b.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

274781|8f560eff.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

274781|ab5dd850.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ab5dd850.text: Between Bixi and Buliwyf, there ain't many weapons they haven't had the pleasure of slashing or smashing an orc with.  You can find them hanging out at the Timberline Arms weapon shop if ye need some training.

274781|ac68ec99.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ac68ec99.text: Yer looking to learn how to use a new weapon are ye?  Well, ye should be talking to Bixi or Buliwyf over at the Timberline Arms weapon shop then lad.  They know their weapons from axes to... uh... zweihanders.

274781|ce6a7b9d.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

2859|2cc67a59.name: Gyll
2859|2cc67a59.text: Fastest gryphons this side of Aerie Peak. Want to take a ride?

2879|0e051c59.name: Karrina Mekenda
2879|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

3059|4711dbab.name: Harutt Thunderhorn
3059|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3698|0e051c59.name: Bolyun
3698|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

5116|8329ccbb.name: Olmin Burningbeard
5116|8329ccbb.text: If you're here to be trained in the tactics and strategy of hunting, you've come to the right place!

5117|a665cdb8.name: Regnus Thundergranite
5117|a665cdb8.text: Wot kin I do fer ye?

5159|9af6c3de.name: Daryl Riknussun
5159|9af6c3de.text: I keep 'em fed, kid. Yep, Daryl Riknussun, at yer service.

5516|4a5716a3.name: Ulfir Ironbeard
5516|4a5716a3.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

5564|568f7020.name: Simon Tanner
5564|568f7020.text: Hmm, I guess I can take on another student. Well, don't just stand there. Tell me what you're looking to learn.

5565|877c4b1d.name: Jillian Tanner
5565|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

5595|d76057bd.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|d76057bd.text: A Cooking trainer is it?  Well then, get yerself over to the Bronze Kettle on the northeastern side of The Great Forge.  Daryl Riknussun will teach ye to make a mighty fine dish that's sure to put the life back in ye!

6669|a5e43d8e.name: The Threshwackonator 4100
6669|a5e43d8e.text: Gelkak's key slides into the vacant slot.

6738|41276936.name: Innkeeper Kimlya
6738|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

8308|c8a70fb5.name: Alenndaar Lapidaar
8308|c8a70fb5.text: What can I do for you my child?

1009-accept.name: Talen
1009-accept.text:
I fear the ancient statuette's secrets will remain forever hidden unless you find the key to its ancient lock.

That key is a ring, the Ring of Zoram.  It belonged to the rulers of this city before the waves of the Sundering drowned it.

For years the ring was lost, but the naga have recently found it.

Their leader, Ruuzel, dwells on an isle on the northern edge of Zoram.  Please, $N, retrieve the ring for me!
1009-accept.title: Ruuzel

1009-complete.name: Talen
1009-complete.text: You found the ring!  Thank you, $N.  Please take this as payment, and know that your deeds today will remain forever in my memory.
1009-complete.title: Ruuzel

1009-progress.name: Talen
1009-progress.text: It is said that the Ring of Zoram is the key to any lock within the city.  Do you have it, $N?
1009-progress.title: Ruuzel

1010-progress.name: Orendil Broadleaf
1010-progress.text: Have you gathered the Bathran's Hair, $N?  The child's health grows weaker by the hour...
1010-progress.title: Bathran's Hair

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

1020-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1020-progress.text: I must apologize, for I have no time to speak.  My child, Relara, is deathly ill!
1020-progress.title: Orendil's Cure

1033-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1033-progress.text: $N, did you find Iris Lake?  Do you have the Tear?
1033-progress.title: Elune's Tear

1140-accept.name: Delgren the Purifier
1140-accept.text:
The writing of the orcs is little better than the scribblings of a child. Many of my order scoffed when I chose to learn their tongue, but I have found it beneficial to gain further understanding of my enemies.

From Ilkrud's scribblings, it appears that Athrikus still possesses two soulgems, and they are being held in Night Run and Satyrnaar, satyr-held areas in northeast Ashenvale.

Be careful out there, $N, the satyrs' blood-soaked temples can be unsettling even for a seasoned $c such as yourself.
1140-accept.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

117-accept.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-accept.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste 
More like beer and less like stew, 
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-accept.title: Thunderbrew

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

2040-complete.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-complete.text: Well done, $N. Thanks to you, Gnomeregan is one step closer to its day of liberation!
2040-complete.title: Underground Assault

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

2078-accept.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2078-accept.text:
Landlubber, ye needs to find me first mate.

Take this'n key, puts it in his gulliver an' bring him back here to serve the Cap'n.

Them murlocs an' their chief ain't gonna be too happy once me first mate gets a hold of em!
2078-accept.title: Gyromast's Revenge

2078-complete.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2078-complete.text:
Yarrr... Ye be provin' yerself to be more than a yella sea dog, landlubber.

The Cap'n may promote ye to poop deck swabby if ye be keepin' this up...
2078-complete.title: Gyromast's Revenge

2098-accept.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2098-accept.text:
A pirate's life ain't an easy one, landlubber. It ain't all about plunderin' and booze! Alas, me ship be sunk just off shore thanks to them pesky Threshadons.

What I be needin' is me first mate back in workin' order!

When I washed up'n shore, the key for me first mate broke on the rocks and was pilfered by the beasties of Darkshore. Out of the corner of me eyes I saw some of them Ragin' Crawlers, Ferocious Foreststrider, and murloc rummaging through the wreckage....
2098-accept.title: Gyromast's Retrieval

2098-complete.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2098-complete.text:
Avast ye scurvy sea dog! Ye did it! Soon me first mate be back in workin' order and them beasties won't know what hit em!

Hrm, have ye seen me first mate?
2098-complete.title: Gyromast's Retrieval

2098-progress.name: Gelkak Gyromast
2098-progress.text: Have ye found me broke down key, landlubber?
2098-progress.title: Gyromast's Retrieval

2139-complete.name: Tharnariun Treetender
2139-complete.text:
You have fought for Auberdine with bravery and honor, $N. In our war torn lands, death and despair are common. Many will not rise to meet the challenge of life in our new home, choosing instead to hide in their homes or escape to the more fortified lands of the Alliance.

Thank you, $N. Perhaps someday soon we shall fight along side as comrades versus another foe.
2139-complete.title: Tharnariun's Hope

244-accept.name: Guard Parker
244-accept.text:
Hail, $c.  I am charged to patrol this stretch of road.  Although the road is safe for now, I've seen gnoll encampments to the north and east of here.

Lakeshire must know of the gathering gnoll force!  Report to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire and tell him of the gnolls.  Do this, and I'm sure Feldon will offer you a scout's wage.

Feldon's usually inspecting the area south of the bridge to Lakeshire.
244-accept.title: Encroaching Gnolls

244-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
244-complete.text:
There are Redridge gnolls that close to Elwynn??  They may be poised to advance into our homeland.  Soon the people of Lakeshire may not be the only humans under siege!

Here is your pay, though you bring us dire news.  And it comes at a bad time, for we are ill equipped to deal with it.
244-complete.title: Encroaching Gnolls

246-accept.name: Deputy Feldon
246-accept.text:
We don't have men to spare, but something must be done about those gnolls you reported to me.

Scout southern Redridge for gnolls.  Harry them, kill those you can and report back to me with a count of their numbers and an assessment of the threat they present.  You may find those gnolls camped all along the southern road of Redridge.

Do this for the Stormwind Army, $N, and you will be rewarded.
246-accept.title: Assessing the Threat

287-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
287-complete.text:
Ah, $N! I didn't think you'd have much trouble finding the place, my directions are excellent, you know...

Let me just finish up my report then.

<He brings out some paper and scribbles on it momentarily.>

There! Well, haha, now this certainly is funny... I don't suppose, $N, that you would mind doing one last favor for me?
287-complete.title: Frostmane Hold

291-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
291-accept.text:
Excellent! Take my report to Senator Barin Redstone. He's a sour type, so don't let his less-than-sunny disposition get to you. He's in Ironforge, in the chamber where King Magni holds court.

Don't know the way to Ironforge? Take the road out of Kharanos north, cross the bridge, then follow the road east--there are large banners flanking the road--up the mountainside.

By the way, if you might avoid mentioning how you assisted me? Can't let them think I'm not working hard out here, you know?
291-accept.title: The Reports

291-progress.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-progress.text: Hmm... it would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. Well, what do you want? Make it quick.
291-progress.title: The Reports

2923-accept.name: Brother Sarno
2923-accept.text:
Tinkmaster Overspark is very upset with the fate of his mechanical creation, Techbot.  I remember Techbot as a kind and helpful tool for the gnomes, but Overspark tells me it's malfunctioned.

Very sad.  But with luck perhaps he can be fixed!

Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark, in Tinker Town in Ironforge.  He would welcome your help.
2923-accept.title: Tinkmaster Overspark

2928-accept.name: Shoni the Shilent
2928-accept.text:
It's terrible, $N. We are not going to have enough parts to get our fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to Dun Morogh.

What we need are spare parts, $N. What better place to get the spare parts for our vehicles than Gnomeregan? I hear that bots and mechs roam around that place like cattle on an open range.

What I need you to do is go to Gnomeregan and tear apart those robots. Bring me back their robot guts. Two dozen should be sufficient.
2928-accept.title: Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators

3091-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
3091-accept.text: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $N. I believe she was sent by the $c trainer Harutt. If this note is from Harutt, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.
3091-accept.title: Simple Note

3091-complete.name: Harutt Thunderhorn
3091-complete.text:
Each of us plays a role in our tribe. Each of us must also go through all the same rites. Do not ever let your pride tell you otherwise.

I remain here to train new warriors that seek the glory of battle and who follow the ways of our oldest ancestors. When you feel ready, come back to me and I will do what I can to train you further. Go with the tribe's blessing, $N.
3091-complete.title: Simple Note

3091-progress.name: Harutt Thunderhorn
3091-progress.text: Ah, at last, you've arrived, $c. I did not lie in my note, $N. We are a special breed also, not unlike the druids or shamans of our tribe. You are just as important. We are the ones called upon to defend our borders, to hunt the centaur, and to go to war.
3091-progress.title: Simple Note

310-complete.name: Unknown
310-complete.text: You quickly place Marleth's barrel of Barleybrew Scalder among the Thunderbrew barrels.
310-complete.title: Bitter Rivals

310-progress.name: Unknown
310-progress.text: The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.
310-progress.title: Bitter Rivals

311-accept.name: Unknown
311-accept.text: Having inserted a barrel of Marleth's Scalder in the Kharanos Distillery's cellar, you grab a barrel of Thunder Ale as proof of the deed...
311-accept.title: Return to Marleth

312-progress.name: Tundra MacGrann
312-progress.text: Were you able to get into my meat locker, $N?
312-progress.title: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash

314-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-progress.text: Vagash still terrorizes the herd!  Please help us by killing the wretched beast.
314-progress.title: Protecting the Herd

315-progress.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-progress.text: Do you have that shimmerweed?  I almost have a batch of stout ready to brew, and I want to try throwing the weed in with this mixture.
315-progress.title: The Perfect Stout

319-complete.name: Rejold Barleybrew
319-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  It'll be nice to work our crafts without hearing so many growls and snorts outside the village.
319-complete.title: A Favor for Evershine

320-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
320-accept.text: Here's your cask of Evershine, $N.  And again, thank you for the hunting earlier.
320-accept.title: Return to Bellowfiz

320-complete.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
320-complete.text: Yes, this will do just fine.  I think I'll open a bottle right now and have a taste...
320-complete.title: Return to Bellowfiz

3376-accept.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-accept.text:
$N - I have heard of you, newcomer.  Perhaps it is you that will help us, where others have failed.

We $r have carved a home out of this land, but not without a cost.  The Bristleback quilboars of Brambleblade Ravine, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, have made our lives difficult with their continued war against us.  I charge you to bring me the chief's head!

He will be found in the ravine to the east in their makeshift village.
3376-accept.title: Break Sharptusk!

3376-progress.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-progress.text:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, $N.

We $r live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
3376-progress.title: Break Sharptusk!

343-accept.name: Brother Kristoff
343-accept.text:
I'm giving a speech on the Fortitude of the Spirit, and I'd like to recite passages from a particular book on metallurgy - "The Stresses of Iron."  A copy of this book should be in the Royal Library, within Stormwind Keep.  Can you retrieve it for me?  If so, then may the blessings of the Light be with you!

The Royal Library is very large, but the head librarian, Milton Sheaf, knows each shelf like it was his own son.  Speak to him, he'll retrieve the book for you.
343-accept.title: Speaking of Fortitude

373-complete.name: Baros Alexston
373-complete.text:
Edwin VanCleef, you say? I would as much expect a letter from my dead grandmother... So you've killed him then? Pardon me in saying, but I'm somewhat surprised. He was a peerless fighter in his younger years. Let's see what he finds the need to write to me about after so many years.

<Baros peruses the letter.>

Edwin... I see the years haven't changed you a bit, an idealist as ever, and a romantic. He doesn't care who he hurts, $N. Revenge has consumed him. But then, I'm not sure I can blame him.
373-complete.title: The Unsent Letter

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

384-complete.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-complete.text:
The Malt is brewed, the Boars are dead
And before all is done and anything said
We will have to fight for first dibs
On these savory Beer Basted Boar Ribs!
384-complete.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

384-progress.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-progress.text: I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, $N.
384-progress.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

387-accept.name: Warden Thelwater
387-accept.text:
The uprising must be quelled!  I need your assistance.  If word gets out that the prison is overrun I will lose my job!  This is a case of foul play if I've ever seen one.  But what's important now is forcing these prisoners into submission for the safety of Stormwind.

The punishment for insurgency is death.  Kill some of these deviants!  That ought to get things under control.
387-accept.title: Quell the Uprising

388-accept.name: Nikova Raskol
388-accept.text:
Bitterness flows through my veins like a cold river.  My grandson, Mac, was such a good boy.  A mere 14 years old.  When the army was sent off to the front, Mac took up arms to defend the city.  He was a guard in The Stockade, where the Defias gang is locked up.  Mac reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their wool blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang.  For that Mac was stabbed in the back.

I want revenge.  Bring me 10 of their precious Wool Bandanas.  They are the color of blood.
388-accept.title: The Color of Blood

389-accept.name: Baros Alexston
389-accept.text:
VanCleef and I were members of the Stonemasons Guild. Our main project was to rebuild Stormwind after the War.

When we had finished our duties, we were cheated. The nobles refused to pay us for our work. Some of the more senior of the Stonemasons were offered governmental jobs, but VanCleef refused it out of loyalty to all the Stonemasons. He led a riot and left the city, swearing revenge.

His lieutenant, Bazil Thredd, might know more about VanCleef's plans. He's being held prisoner in the Stockade.
389-accept.title: Bazil Thredd

389-complete.name: Warden Thelwater
389-complete.text:
What in the Light do you want? Can't you see we have a crisis here?

Bazil Thredd?! Why would you want to speak with that bastard? How am I supposed to know you're not one of his cronies, come down to help with his bloody riot? If all the blasted cells weren't open, I might throw you in one for a while!
389-complete.title: Bazil Thredd

391-accept.name: Warden Thelwater
391-accept.text:
Let's get one thing straight, $N: I don't trust you. But, with the situation as it is, you probably won't make a difference.

So here's how it's going to be: go down there and have your talk with Thredd. If you're really on our side, then kill him and bring me his head when the job's done. And if it turns out you're on his side, and don't come out... when we find you, you'll die along with the rest of the maggots.
391-accept.title: The Stockade Riots

413-progress.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
413-progress.text:
Hello, $C!  And what business takes you all the way out here?

Something exciting, I hope.  I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...
413-progress.title: Shimmer Stout

417-progress.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
417-progress.title: A Pilot's Revenge

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

4727-accept.name: Unknown
4727-accept.text: The skeletal remains of a sea turtle lie in the sand of the northern Darkshore beaches.  The Greymist murlocs have either not found this carcass, or perhaps they have and are shying away from it for some unknown reason.  Regardless, there is enough of the turtle left to take a sample back to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine for the Temple of the Moon to study.
4727-accept.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4727-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4727-complete.text: It is interesting that the murlocs were not present at this site; we will keep this in mind as we study this creature's remains!  Thank you for your effort, $N; the Temple of the Moon would like for me to give you this, as compensation for your time.
4727-complete.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4727-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4727-progress.text: Hello once again $N - have you found any more beached creatures that the Temple of the Moon should know about?
4727-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4763-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
4763-complete.text: We have just begun this war to reclaim our forest from the forces of corruption, but a battle this day has been won!  $N, the people of Auberdine owe you a debt of gratitude that will never be easily repaid.  Please accept this along with our thanks.  What we have learned here today may one day free our furbolg friends from the shackles of torment permanently.
4763-complete.title: The Blackwood Corrupted

4763-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4763-progress.text: The Talisman of Corruption is a sinister device that only serves to pervert the balance of nature.  When you obtain this item from whatever satyr is tormenting the furbolgs and bring it to me for disposal, we will have won a great victory this day!
4763-progress.title: The Blackwood Corrupted

5545-progress.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
5545-progress.title: A Bundle of Trouble

6387-progress.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
6387-progress.text: Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon?  Are you ready to leave for another city?
6387-progress.title: Honor Students

6388-progress.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-progress.text: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
6388-progress.title: Gryth Thurden

6391-progress.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-progress.text: What can I do for you, sir?
6391-progress.title: Ride to Ironforge

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6662-progress.name: Nipsy
6662-progress.text:
<Nipsy puts his index finger through one of the air holes in the carton.>

Alive and kicking... and just in time!
6662-progress.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

71-progress.name: Guard Thomas
71-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
71-progress.title: Report to Thomas

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

750-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-complete.text: The $r of Narache thank you for these provisions, $N. With your skill in the ways of the hunt you will surely be revered in Thunder Bluff someday.
750-complete.title: The Hunt Continues

750-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-progress.text: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
750-progress.title: The Hunt Continues

753-complete.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-complete.text:
You carried this pitcher back at the Greatmother's bidding, I see.

Your willingness to help others and provide for the $r of Camp Narache leads me to believe you would make the tribe proud in Thunder Bluff someday.
753-complete.title: A Humble Task

753-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-progress.text: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
753-progress.title: A Humble Task

755-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
755-accept.text:
Your willingness to perform a humble task for the $r of Narache and your eagerness to learn are noble traits, $N. I believe one day you will be heralded in Thunder Bluff as a $c of greatness.

Before that you must embark on the Rites of the Earthmother, of which there are three.

The first test is the Rite of Strength. Travel to Seer Graytongue and tell him Chief Hawkwind has sent you.

You will find the seer's abode directly to the south of Camp Narache, tucked away in the hills.
755-accept.title: Rites of the Earthmother

755-complete.name: Seer Graytongue
755-complete.text: Chief Hawkwind sent you? Embarking on the Rites of the Earthmother is no small task...
755-complete.title: Rites of the Earthmother

757-accept.name: Seer Graytongue
757-accept.text:
The Rites of the Earthmother are the steps a young $r needs to take to gain respect in Thunder Bluff.

First you must pass the Rite of Strength. In this test you must prove your bravery by slaying enemies of the tribe.

Bristlebacks of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal lands. They ambush our hunting parties and steal from the village by dark.

Show your valor by slaying these villains and return to the Chief in Camp Narache with their belts as proof of your deeds.
757-accept.title: Rite of Strength

757-complete.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-complete.text: You have passed the first test of the Rites of the Earthmother. The tribe will be proud.
757-complete.title: Rite of Strength

757-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-progress.text: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, $N? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
757-progress.title: Rite of Strength

763-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
763-accept.text:
For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, $N.

Travel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Chief, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Take this totem to Baine. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.

Follow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.
763-accept.title: Rites of the Earthmother

780-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-accept.text:
The Battleboars of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal hunting grounds. They are trained to be malicious by the Bristleback Quilboars with whom we are at war.

Go and slay the vile creatures and bring back some snouts and flanks so that we can make stew for our young.
780-accept.title: The Battleboars

780-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-progress.text: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780-progress.title: The Battleboars

91740-complete.name: Merell Ross
91740-complete.text: We lost two members of the watch last week to the murlocs, $c. Hopefully with their leader slain, we can start pushing them out of Elwynn.
91740-complete.title: Croaky's Head

945-complete.name: Therysil
945-complete.text:
My sister was where??  Therylune doesn't mind getting herself dirty, but still!  That's a long way to wander, and the Master's Glaive is an unwholesome place...

Well thank you, $N.  It was very nice of you to let me know she's all right.
945-complete.title: Therylune's Escape

951-complete.name: Onu
951-complete.text:
Thank you.  These relics are from a time when Mathystra shone.  That once great bastion of the elves has faded, but shards of its magic remain.  Let us hope we can unlock the secrets of that place before our enemies...

Be vigilant, $N.
951-complete.title: Mathystra Relics

951-progress.name: Onu
951-progress.text: $N.  Has your rooting through the Ruins of Mathystra been fruitful?
951-progress.title: Mathystra Relics

95213-accept.name: Unknown
95213-accept.text:
The keg is stamped:

BLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER

You get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.
95213-accept.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95214-complete.name: Quarrymaster Thesten
95214-complete.text:
That should be all the stolen powder. Thank you, $c.

Please accept this reward, and... I'd appreciate if you didn't mention this little incident to anyone.
95214-complete.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95214-progress.name: Quarrymaster Thesten
95214-progress.text: I hope you've got good news for me?
95214-progress.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

95805-progress.name: Seer Graytongue
95805-progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805-progress.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

96391-accept.name: Unknown
96391-accept.text:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.>
96391-accept.title: Underground Map

96392-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96392-complete.text:
So ye see now, $c? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.

Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. How's about a bit o' violence?
96392-complete.title: Farsen's Watch

96393-complete.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
96393-complete.text:
A Dark Iron incursion--right beneath our feet? Well, I'm relieved to hear that the Dark Iron commander has been dispatched.

The guards will head in and clean up the rest of the rabble. We'll see to it that the breaches are sealed and the lower levels reinforced to ensure that no further incursions are possible.

Thank ye for yer service to Ironforge, $c. Take this as a small token of my gratitude. Oh, and if ye see that old Wildhammer rockhugger Farsen again, tell 'em to pay me a proper visit.
96393-complete.title: Old Ironforge Incursion

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-complete.name: Thom Filch
96403-complete.text:
Look at you, as brave as you are enterprising! I'm a gnome of my word, and your reward is well earned! 

Now, let me take a look at the haul--uh, I mean... the recovered heirlooms. I need to get started appraising--excuse me, 'cataloging' them so that they can be put back in their proper places as quickly as possible.
96403-complete.title: Important Heirlooms

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

967-complete.name: Delgren the Purifier
967-complete.text:
If you don't mind my saying, you seem a bit well-equipped for a messenger, hm? I suppose Balthule wanted to be certain that his letter reached my hands. Let's see what he has to say...

This is disturbing news. When undead or demonic forces are found, I help the Sentinels destroy them.

At first I was unaccustomed to the manners of the night elves, but I have grown to respect them greatly as allies.
967-complete.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

967-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
967-progress.text: You have some business with me, $c?
967-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

970-accept.name: Delgren the Purifier
970-accept.text:
Balthule's letter is dire. This Cult of the Dark Strand is a thorn in my side that must be removed. I have been dealing with some of the Dark Strand scum northeast of here at Ordil'Aran. One of their number possesses a soul gem that I believe holds the secret to the cult's power.

Bring it to me, and I will be able to decipher the secrets held within.
970-accept.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

970-complete.name: Delgren the Purifier
970-complete.text: Hmm, some dark magic enchants this soulstone. Let's see what's trapped inside, shall we?
970-complete.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

970-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
970-progress.text: Have you acquired that soul gem?
970-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

973-accept.name: Delgren the Purifier
973-accept.text:
Ilkrud Magthrull. Yes, I have knowledge of him. He is a powerful orc warlock that makes his residence at the Fire Scar Shrine,  a place of great evil in southwestern Ashenvale.

He had been little more than an annoyance until now, and I had not dealt with him, but it seems that his time has come.
973-accept.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

973-complete.name: Delgren the Purifier
973-complete.text:
It was a grand thing you did today, $N. You should be quite proud of yourself for having faced down a warlock of such power.

Now, let's see what we can learn from Ilkrud's writings.
973-complete.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

973-progress.name: Delgren the Purifier
973-progress.text: You look a bit shaken up, $N. Are you well?
973-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

97914-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
97914-accept.text:
Auberdine is a humble place, $c. You won't hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.

Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.

I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you to join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a $r called Baros Alexston.

Make our home known.
97914-accept.title: Expanding Horizons

98323-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
98323-progress.text:
Ah, you're back just in time.

What's the matter, lad? You look like you've seen a ghost.
98323-progress.title: Secure the Mountain

98423-complete.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-complete.text:
Ah yes, my ancestor Madoran was the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge following the great civil war between the Wildhammer, Bronzebeard, and Dark Iron clans. This treaty was drafted to codify the cessation of hostilities and terms of peace after the Bronzebeards won the mountain.

As you can see, the Wildhammers and Bronzebeards signed it... and the Dark Irons did not.

Thank you for recovering this and bringing it to me, $c.
98423-complete.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98423-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-progress.text: What have you brought from the depths, $c.
98423-progress.title: The Treaty of Understanding

986-complete.name: Terenthis
986-complete.text:
These will do nicely, $N. I shall set to work on the cloak immediately.

Give me a few moments, then return to me.

Oh, one more thing: after you've used the enchantment on the cloak you'll be limited in your interactions with others. If you can help it, do no more than speak to others. Much more than that could dispel the illusion.
986-complete.title: A Lost Master

986-progress.name: Terenthis
986-progress.text: I can't in good conscience permit you to seek Volcor until I've crafted that cloak for you.
986-progress.title: A Lost Master

990-accept.name: Sentinel Selarin
990-accept.text:
$N, my mistress, Raene Wolfrunner, awaits you in the city of Astranaar within Ashenvale. With your help, perhaps we can at least ease some of the corruption that's taken hold there.

Head south from here and stay close to the road--you'll find your way there without issue if you follow those directions.
990-accept.title: Trek to Ashenvale

99158-progress.name: Father Gavin
99158-progress.text: Why did the Light guide you here today?
99158-progress.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99159-progress.name: Father Gavin
99159-progress.text: Light guide you on your tasks.
99159-progress.title: Finding Warmth

99161-complete.name: Father Gavin
99161-complete.text: Light bless you, $c. Your efforts make this area much safer and hopefully will prevent unnecessary deaths.
99161-complete.title: Rime's Wrath

993-accept.name: Terenthis
993-accept.text:
The cloak is complete, $N. The time has come to find Volcor. I can only hope we are in time.

The cloak's magic, once invoked, will not last long; perhaps five minutes. It will be up to you to know when to use it: I would suggest waiting until you find Grimclaw.

If what he has told me is true, you will find his master in a cave south of here. Grimclaw will be alongside the road waiting for you. Signal to him by waving when you see him, and he'll point the way towards his master.
993-accept.title: A Lost Master
